course.title: Advanced Geometric Topology, Global Geometry & Mathematical Physics
course.instructional_model: Pre-Algebra lesson logic matured for proof, computation, research, and oral defense.

units.title: Classification of Surfaces & Low-Dimensional Topology
topics: Polygonal models, edge identifications, and quotient surfaces
Classification theorem for compact connected surfaces
Surface groups, homology, orientability, and Euler characteristic

units.title: Knot & Link Theory
topics: Knots, links, diagrams, ambient isotopy, and Reidemeister moves
Knot groups, Seifert surfaces, and classical invariants
Braids, torus knots, computation, and scientific applications

units.title: Three-Manifolds & Geometric Topology
topics: Handlebodies, Heegaard splittings, lens spaces, and surgery intuition
Prime and JSJ decomposition; geometric structures
Hyperbolic geometry, knot complements, and topology–geometry interaction

units.title: Computational Topology & Persistent Homology
topics: Simplicial complexes, boundary matrices, filtrations, and chain computation
Persistent homology, barcodes, persistence diagrams, and stability
Topological data analysis, noise, interpretation, and model limitations

units.title: Morse Theory & Handle Decompositions
topics: Morse functions, critical points, Hessians, and Morse index
Handle attachments, CW connections, and Morse inequalities
Gradient flows, Morse–Smale ideas, and computational Morse theory

units.title: Geometric Flows
topics: Curve-shortening and mean-curvature flow
Ricci flow foundations and curvature evolution
Singularities, self-similarity, surgery, and topology

units.title: Global Riemannian Geometry, Comparison & Rigidity
topics: Jacobi fields, conjugate points, and second variation
Comparison geometry and curvature bounds
Rigidity, finiteness, diameter, volume, and equality cases

units.title: Geometry of Relativity
topics: Lorentzian geometry, causal vectors, light cones, and geodesics
Curvature, Einstein geometry, and stress-energy
Schwarzschild geometry, horizons, completeness, causality, and lensing

units.title: Gauge Geometry, Connections & Holonomy
topics: Principal bundles, structure groups, and gauge transformations
Connections, curvature forms, parallel transport, holonomy, and Bianchi identity
U(1), Yang–Mills foundations, and global gauge structure

units.title: Characteristic Classes & Global Bundle Invariants
topics: Euler, Chern, and Stiefel–Whitney classes as obstructions
Chern–Weil viewpoint, characteristic numbers, and topological charge

units.title: Geometry, Physics & Modern Applications
topics: Geometric mechanics, robotics, shape spaces, and optimization on manifolds
Topological phases, defects, geometric learning, and frontier applications

units.title: Advanced Mathematical Research Methods
topics: Primary literature, theorem-dependency maps, and claim classification
Reproducible mathematical computing, testing, precision, and failure analysis

units.title: Research Capstone, Synthesis & Oral Defense
topics: Research build: theorem sequence, models, examples, counterexamples, computation
Revision, reproduction, peer challenge, and oral-defense rehearsal
Final defense, correction cycle, portfolio, abstract, and future research
